translation: If the crown bone collapses, startling the brain and marrow, with bleeding from the seven orifices (七竅), the body stiff and rigid in faint, and the person dull and dazed with no awareness at all, it is untreatable. <ins>Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏)</ins> Treats injuries from beating and falling, broken bones and turned sinews, congealed stagnant blood, and disperses blue-purple swelling and pain and similar conditions. Antelope horn blood (羚羊血, five qian), myrrh (沒藥, five qian), leak reed (漏蘆, three qian), safflower (紅花, three qian), rhubarb (大黃, two qian), musk (麝香, three qian), cimicifuga (升麻, three qian), bletilla (白及, five qian), raw gardenia (生梔子, two qian), licorice (甘草, two qian), bright realgar (明雄黃, five qian), ampelopsis (白蘞, three qian). Grind all together into a fine powder, boil with strong vinegar into an ointment, and apply to the top of the head.
